about: The numbers of the Node terminal UI on the baseline machine that perf_pty.rs must not be worse than. A number is null until it is recorded; perf_pty.rs fails on a null and prints what it measured.

source.launcher: scripts/tui-perf-run.ps1 (MIXDOG_TUI_PERF, MIXDOG_TUI_LOOP_PROBE probes; output in tui-perf.log)
source.transcriptFrameBench: scripts/tui-runtime-load-bench.mjs (frame_time.p95_ms; its own gate is the checked-in baseline p95 times 1.5, then the 16.67 ms floor)

definitions.firstFrameMs: median over three starts against a running core: from the start of the process to the first frame that shows the prompt box (the core's own start is not in it: the first start of the run only starts the core)
definitions.keystrokeToFrameMs: median over 40 keystrokes typed one at a time into an empty prompt: from the write of the byte to the chunk of output that shows the character in the prompt
definitions.streamCharsPerSecond: from the Enter that submits a prompt to the frame that shows the last line of a 600-line streamed answer, the answer's characters divided by that time
